antcolonies.configuration.adultLifespanM: Average minutes an adult ant lives. A colony without a Queen dwindles; with one, eggs replace the dead.
antcolonies.configuration.ant3DModels.to: Draw the ants on top of a Terrarium as 3D models up close. False draws them as 2D sprites like the ants in the tunnels: they look flatter but cost far less, which helps with many colonies in view.
antcolonies.configuration.antCost.toolti: Ants a hunter colony gives up for one Guard Ant (a Rally Pheromone used on its Terrarium).
antcolonies.configuration.antDetailDista: Blocks within which the ants on top of a Terrarium are 3D models (if ant3DModels is on); further away (where they are a pixel or two) they are 2D sprites, which are far cheaper to draw.
antcolonies.configuration.anthillAlarmSe: Seconds an anthill stays alarmed at a player who opened one of its chests, stepped into its Queen's chamber or struck one of its ants (even in a full Chitin set, its ants attack them meanwhile).
antcolonies.configuration.baseEggsPerMin: Eggs a Queen with average genetics lays per minute with one Nest Chamber.
antcolonies.configuration.baseMutationCh: Chance a daughter Queen is born with a random mutation (before Mutation Probability).
Stacked bonuses (genetics x mutations x upgrades) above 1 count as bonus^exponent, so they can't multiply without end. 1 = no softening; 0.6 turns x20 into x6.
antcolonies.configuration.chamberBaseCap: Ants one Foraging Site, Harvesting Site or Hunting Ground takes before Population Upgrades.
antcolonies.configuration.chamberCapacit: Ants each Population Upgrade tier adds to one of those sites.
antcolonies.configuration.chitinFindChan: Chance per Foraging Site find that the ants also bring back chitin (shed and left by ants): Chitin Plates, Hardened Chitin from colony stage 2 (more at stage 3), Infernal Chitin in the Nether, Void Chitin in the End. 0 turns it off.
antcolonies.configuration.connectorRange: How far apart two Colony Connectors may be and still link: at most this many blocks apart on x and on z (height doesn't count). Connectors further apart on the same channel don't trade.
antcolonies.configuration.detailedColony: The Terrarium screen in Detailed Mode (exact numbers, rates per minute, efficiency) instead of Visual Mode (pictures, bars and short notes). The screen's mode button switches it and remembers the choice here.
antcolonies.configuration.eggHatchMinute: Average minutes until an egg hatches into a larva.
antcolonies.configuration.expeditionRoll: Nether and End Foraging Sites: expedition finds per minute per effective worker, before the expedition's own rate (data/<namespace>/antcolonies/expedition/*.json).
antcolonies.configuration.farmerByproduc: Garden harvests (mushrooms, seeds, berries) per minute per effective farmer.
antcolonies.configuration.farmerFood.too: Food per minute per effective farmer, before the species' own food production.
antcolonies.configuration.focusedForagin: Foraging Site modes: how much more often a Mineral or Organic Gathering site picks the finds of its kind (item tag antcolonies:foraging/mineral; everything else is organic).
Foraging Site modes: how often a focused site still picks the finds of the other kind (1 = as often as Balanced).
antcolonies.configuration.foodUpgradeSav: Share of food saved per Food Efficiency Upgrade tier (at most 75% in total).
antcolonies.configuration.foundingFoodSh: Queen-only founding (a single Queen put into a completely empty Terrarium): the share of the Terrarium's own food room (terrariumFoodCapacity) the player must fill before the Queen lays her first eggs. 1 = a full food bar. Colonies started or moved with workers, eggs or larvae never need this.
antcolonies.configuration.foundingWorker: Adults a founding Queen's first brood must raise before the colony counts as founded and runs like any other.
antcolonies.configuration.generatorOutpu: FE a Generator makes per tick while it burns fuel (one coal burns for 1600 ticks).
Most FE a Generator gives to the blocks around it per tick.
antcolonies.configuration.hungryFoodWork: The least speed of the jobs that bring food in (Harvesting Sites and Hunting Grounds) while food is low or out, so a hungry colony can always feed itself again.
antcolonies.configuration.huntFood.toolt: Food a colony gets from each mob its hunters catch (they feed on it).
antcolonies.configuration.huntRolls.tool: Simulated hunts per minute per effective hunter, before hunting strength.
antcolonies.configuration.hunter.tooltip: Food an ant hunting at a Hunting Ground eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.hunterCasualty: Chance a hunt costs one hunter, before the hunters' strength.
antcolonies.configuration.idleActivity.t: How much an ant without a job eats, compared to a busy one.
antcolonies.configuration.inheritanceVar: Chance per trait that a daughter Queen's level differs by one from her mother's.
antcolonies.configuration.interval.toolt: Ticks between colony simulation steps. Larger steps cost less and give the same totals.
antcolonies.configuration.labCostMultipl: Multiplier on Genetic Laboratory material costs (rounded up, at least 1).
antcolonies.configuration.labTimeMultipl: Multiplier on Genetic Laboratory processing times.
antcolonies.configuration.larva.tooltip: Food a larva eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.larvaeGrowMinu: Average minutes until a larva becomes an adult (before genetics and Nest Chambers).
Work, egg laying and growth speed of a colony whose food is just about gone (but not yet starving).
antcolonies.configuration.lowFoodMinutes: Below this many minutes of food left (food / what the colony eats per minute), a colony works, lays and raises its larvae more slowly, down to lowFoodFactor when the food runs out (0 turns this off; starving uses starvedFactor).
antcolonies.configuration.maintenanceFra: Share of a colony's adults that must stay home to clean the nest and tend the brood. Workers kept for maintenance are never assigned to a job; too few of them lower colony health.
antcolonies.configuration.maxBeneficialM: Most beneficial mutations one Queen can carry (flaws don't count).
antcolonies.configuration.maxChambers.to: Most chambers one colony takes. Touching chambers beyond it (the furthest from the Terrarium) don't join.
antcolonies.configuration.maxColonyPopul: Hard cap on the adults of one colony, whatever its housing.
antcolonies.configuration.maxFoodPerMinu: Most food one Colony Connector moves per minute (its own setting can be lower).
antcolonies.configuration.maxItemsPerMin: Most items one sending Colony Connector moves out of its colony's Storage per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.maxLevelMultip: Effect of a trait at the maximum level.
Highest level the Genetic Laboratory can raise a trait to.
Most animated ants drawn in one Terrarium (they only show the colony; they never decide anything).
antcolonies.configuration.nestChamberAdu: Adults each Nest Chamber adds (plus half as many again per Population Upgrade tier).
antcolonies.configuration.nestChamberLar: Larvae each Nest Chamber holds on top of the Terrarium's own room.
antcolonies.configuration.nestCooldownSe: Seconds a wild nest needs to recover after ants were taken from it.
antcolonies.configuration.nestCropGrowth: Chance per tick that an ant from a home nest, standing at a crop or sapling, grows it a stage (0 turns tending off).
antcolonies.configuration.nestGrowthBonu: Larvae growth speed added by each Nest Chamber (diminishing).
antcolonies.configuration.nestHarvest.to: Ants from a home nest harvest ripe crops around it, replant them and carry the harvest into the nest.
antcolonies.configuration.nestLayingBonu: Egg laying added by each Nest Chamber after the first (diminishing).
antcolonies.configuration.nestQueenChanc: Chance Tweezers pull a Queen instead of workers from a wild nest.
antcolonies.configuration.noNestChamberF: Egg laying speed of a Queen without any Nest Chamber.
antcolonies.configuration.offlineCatchUp: Minutes of simulation a colony catches up on when its Terrarium loads again after being unloaded. Production never runs while unloaded; this is the most it can make up afterwards (0 = none).
antcolonies.configuration.populationExpo: Diminishing returns: n ants on one kind of job (all of a colony's sites of that kind together) work like n^exponent ants.
antcolonies.configuration.queen.tooltip: Food a Queen eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.queenChance.to: Chance a naturally spawned wild ant is a Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.queenGrowthMin: A Queen grows with her colony: minutes her colony must spend at a bigger stage before she grows into it, times the step (stage 2 takes this, stage 3 twice this, stage 4 three times). Each new stage raises two of her traits.
antcolonies.configuration.queenRearingMi: Adults a colony needs before its Queen Chamber can raise a new Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.rareFindMultip: Multiplier on the chance of every rare ("special") find: diamonds, netherite scrap, shells, sponges, sniffer eggs... 0.5 halves them, 0 turns them off, 2 doubles them. Common finds are not changed (lower scavengeRolls for those). Hunting loot comes from mob loot tables and is not affected (use huntRolls).
Foraging finds per minute per effective worker, before the species' own rate.
antcolonies.configuration.simulationUpgr: Extra catch-up minutes from a Simulation Upgrade of tier 1, 2 and 3.
Chance a naturally spawned wild ant is a soldier.
antcolonies.configuration.spawnChance.to: Chance a natural spawn attempt of a wild ant succeeds (0 turns them off).
antcolonies.configuration.speciesUpgrade: Strength of species-specific upgrades per tier.
antcolonies.configuration.speedUpgradeBo: Work speed added per Speed Upgrade tier.
antcolonies.configuration.stagePopulatio: Adults a colony needs for stages 2, 3 and 4 (stage 4 also needs a mineral or better species, or average genetics of 5 or more).
antcolonies.configuration.startingLevelW: Weights of starting trait levels 1 to 10 for a new wild Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.starvationDecl: Share of the population lost per minute of starvation after the grace period.
antcolonies.configuration.starvationGrac: Minutes without food before the population starts to die.
antcolonies.configuration.starvationKill: Whether a Queen dies once her colony has starved down to nothing.
Work, egg laying and growth speed of a colony without food.
antcolonies.configuration.storageFeeding: Colonies eat food items from their own Storage and Foraging Sites whenever there is room for them (feeding comes first). Items in the tag antcolonies:kept_in_storage (Royal Jelly) are never eaten.
antcolonies.configuration.storageFoodCap: Food room each Storage adds (more with Storage Upgrades).
antcolonies.configuration.storageSlotsPe: Storage slots each Storage Upgrade tier adds (a Storage starts with 18, at most 162).

guide.antcolonies.automation.text:
Hoppers and pipes can feed the Terrarium and Queen Chambers, and empty Storage and Foraging Sites. A Storage with an Automation Upgrade pushes its finds into the container under it.
Comparators read a Terrarium's food, a site's workforce, or how full a store is. A redstone signal pauses a site: its ants go elsewhere.
guide.antcolonies.automation.title: Automation
guide.antcolonies.building.text:
No two anthills are dug alike: each nest grows room by room, small, medium or large, with nurseries, food stores, fungus gardens, aphid farms, middens to brush, barracks and treasure chambers, side entrances, loops and dead ends. Their look follows the biome: termite spires in savannas and badlands, a crater in the desert, a thatched dome in the taiga, snow, moss or mud elsewhere. The Nether and the End have anthills too.
Deepest of all, behind her royal guard, lies the great Queen. In a full Chitin set the ants let you pass, until you open one of their chests, step into her chamber or strike one of them: then the whole anthill attacks.
Their walls are Anthill Soil. From it, Chitin Plates, Ant Resin (Wood Ants find it), mushrooms and Royal Jelly come five families of building blocks, with stairs, slabs and walls, a Nest Door and a Pheromone Lamp.
guide.antcolonies.building.title: Anthills and Building
guide.antcolonies.chambers.text:
Chambers are additions. Put one against the Terrarium, or against a chamber already in the colony, on any side (above and below too): it joins, and the glass between them goes: the whole build becomes one glass case. A colony takes up to 32.
Nest Chamber: eggs at full speed, faster larvae, room for 3,000 adults and 1,500 larvae. Without one the Queen lays at half speed and only 60 adults fit.
Foraging Site: workers find the species' resources. It sends its finds to the Storage, and holds 9 stacks while the Storage is full.
Harvesting Site: Farmer Ants grow food and harvest there.
Hunting Ground: hunter species (Army Ants and the ants that evolve into hunters) kill mobs there: the mobs' loot, and food from what they catch.
Storage: more room for finds, and food room.
Queen Chamber: raises new Queens.
A chamber exactly as near to two Terrariums joins neither.
guide.antcolonies.chambers.title: The Colony Build
guide.antcolonies.climate.text:
Every species likes a climate: temperate, cold, hot, underground or nether. In the wrong one the colony loses health, less with good Environmental Resistance.
A block under the Terrarium fixes it: snow or ice make it cold, sand or sandstone hot, grass or dirt temperate, stone or deepslate underground, netherrack or magma nether. The Terrarium's Info page shows the blocks for your colony.
guide.antcolonies.climate.title: Climate
guide.antcolonies.connectors.text:
A Colony Connector joins a colony like any chamber. Connectors with the same channel colour in one dimension link their colonies when they are at most 30 blocks apart (on x and on z), as long as both are loaded.
Supply gives the food a colony has above its reserve; Request takes food up to its target, the hungriest colony first. Send moves the items in its filter out of the colony's Storage to colonies that Receive.
A Farmer colony supplying food lets mining and hunting colonies put more ants to work. The Terrarium's Network page shows the network.
guide.antcolonies.connectors.title: Colony Connectors
guide.antcolonies.evolution.text:
Queens evolve into new species: feed the Terrarium the right material once the colony is big enough (the Info page lists it). A try may fail, but one always works after enough tries. An Evolution Catalyst helps.
A Queen Chamber raises daughter Queens from the colony's Queen; with a Genetic Sample of another species it can raise a hybrid.
guide.antcolonies.evolution.title: Evolution
guide.antcolonies.expeditions.text:
Take a colony to the Nether (or the End) and let it forage there: now and then its Foraging Sites find a Nether (or End) Trail Pheromone.
Back home, build a Nether Foraging Site (obsidian, Infernal Chitin, a Foraging Site and two Nether Trail Pheromones) or an End Foraging Site (end stone bricks, Void Chitin, an eye of ender, a Foraging Site and two End Trail Pheromones).
Nether-adapted ants (Warped, Fire, Inferno, Soul, Netherite, Wither, Crimson) and End-adapted ants (Chorus, Ender, Dragon) then go on expeditions through its little portal and bring back that dimension's finds. Nothing really travels: no power and no chunk loading.
guide.antcolonies.expeditions.title: Expeditions
guide.antcolonies.food.text:
Ants eat. Food goes in the Terrarium's food slot (beside the feed slot), by hand, by right-clicking the Terrarium or from a hopper: Ant Food, Royal Jelly, sugar, sweet berries and other plain foods. The Terrarium holds 2,000 food; each Storage adds 25,000.
Mineral and crystal species need their own food for their eggs. A starving colony works slowly, then loses ants.
Farmer Ants at a Harvesting Site grow food themselves.
guide.antcolonies.food.title: Food
guide.antcolonies.founding.text:
Every anthill has a Queen to catch. Put her into a completely empty Terrarium on her own and she founds a colony: fill the food bar (ten Ant Food) and she lays her first eggs. When her first 10 workers are grown, the colony is founded.
Put her in with workers, eggs or larvae instead (or move a colony across in its tubes) and the colony runs at once: founding is only for a Queen alone.
Food keeps a colony working: with less than 10 minutes of food left it slows down, and with none it starves. Farmer Ants at Harvesting Sites grow food, and Colony Connectors bring it from other colonies.
guide.antcolonies.founding.title: Founding a Colony
guide.antcolonies.gear.text:
Chitin tools and armor come in four tiers. Chitin (from Chitin Plates) is iron level; Hardened is crafted the same way from Hardened Chitin and lasts three times as long.
Infernal: at a smithing table, a Hardened piece with an Infernal Reinforcement and an Infernal Chitin. Diamond level and fireproof. Void: an Infernal piece with a Void Reinforcement and a netherite ingot. Past netherite.
Reinforcements are crafted two at a time: Infernal from Infernal Chitin, blaze rods, magma cream and a ghast tear; Void from Void Chitin, shulker shells, popped chorus fruit and an eye of ender.
Any four chitin armor pieces are a full set: wild ants leave you alone, until you raid their anthill. The lowest tier you wear sets the rest: digging 20, 25, 30 or 40% faster, and from Infernal up Fire Resistance.
guide.antcolonies.gear.title: Chitin Gear
guide.antcolonies.genetics.text:
Each Queen has ten traits from 1 to 10, and daughters inherit them with small changes. Mutations add strengths, or flaws.
The Genetic Laboratory raises one trait at a time, rerolls, mutates and purges flaws. It runs on FE: put a Generator next to it, or any mod's cable.
guide.antcolonies.genetics.title: Genetics
guide.antcolonies.jobs.text:
Workers go to Harvesting Sites and Hunting Grounds first (they bring food), then to Foraging Sites. A twentieth of the adults stay home to look after the nest.
Each site takes up to 256 ants, more with Population Upgrades. Its screen sets how many it wants; Auto takes all it can.
The more ants on a job, the more they find, a little less for each extra ant. Only Farmer species farm, and only hunter species hunt: the Info page says which.
guide.antcolonies.jobs.title: Jobs
guide.antcolonies.start.text:
Craft Tweezers and some Test Tubes. Find wild ants or an Ant Nest and use the Tweezers on them: the ants go into an empty Test Tube in your inventory. Queens are rare; nests give one now and then.
Place a Terrarium, put the Queen Test Tube in, then some Ant Food. The Queen starts laying eggs at once: a Terrarium works on its own.
The Terrarium's screen shows the colony: its ants, genes, jobs and numbers, and on the Info page what its ants are like.
To move a colony, take it out in Test Tubes: an empty tube in the Queen slot takes the Queen out, empty tubes in the feed slot fill with ants (up to 1,000 each), and the Colony page's Take out buttons do the same from your inventory. Then break the Terrarium and put the tubes into a new one. Ants left inside a broken Terrarium are lost.
guide.antcolonies.start.title: Getting Started
guide.antcolonies.upgrades.text:
Upgrades go in a screen's upgrade slots; shift-clicking one puts it there. Each block takes the kinds it can use: the slot's tooltip, and JEI or EMI, tell which.
The Colony Upgrade Station makes species upgrades from an Upgrade Base and a species' signature material. They work only for that species, in Foraging Sites.
guide.antcolonies.upgrades.title: Upgrades

species.antcolonies.abyssal.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Lapis Ants that dives for the ocean monuments' treasures: prismarine, sea lanterns and sponges.
species.antcolonies.aluminum.desc: Light, quick Iron Ants fed aluminum. Bring aluminum.
species.antcolonies.amethyst.desc: Living geodes that glow violet in the dark. Prefer to live underground.
species.antcolonies.army.desc: Nomad hunters of plains and savannas that live anywhere. At a Hunting Ground they swarm zombies, skeletons and spiders, and feed on the catch.
species.antcolonies.badlands.desc: Rust-red ants of the badlands. Bring red sand and terracotta in all the badlands colors, and a little gold.
species.antcolonies.blossom.desc: Pink ants of cherry groves and flower meadows. Bring flowers for every dye, petals, cherry wood and honeycomb.
species.antcolonies.bullet.desc: Jungle Ants fed gunpowder. Their sting fells creepers and witches: gunpowder, redstone and glowstone come home.
species.antcolonies.certus.desc: Amethyst Ants fed certus quartz. Bring certus quartz for Applied Energistics, and fluix at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.chorus.desc: Pale violet ants of the End's outer islands. Bring end stone, chorus fruit and purpur; fed eyes of ender in the End they become Ender Ants.
species.antcolonies.coal.desc: Soot-black ants evolved from Stone Ants fed coal. A steady supply of fuel for furnaces and Generators.
species.antcolonies.common.desc: The starting species of plains and forests. Brings back soil, seeds, sticks and odds and ends.
species.antcolonies.copper.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed copper. Their shells go green with age, like old roofs.
species.antcolonies.crimson.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Fire Ants that grows Nether fungus. Tends Harvesting Sites for food, wart and shroomlight.
species.antcolonies.crystal_wood.desc: A hybrid of Wood and Diamond Ants: forest ants whose bark has turned to crystal.
species.antcolonies.deepslate.desc: Stone Ants that went down. Live best underground; bring deepslate, tuff, dripstone and glow lichen.
species.antcolonies.desert.desc: Fast, heat-loving ants of deserts and badlands. Bring sand, sandstone and cactus, and sometimes gold.
species.antcolonies.diamond.desc: Rare crystal ants grown from Gold or Lapis lines. Bring diamond fragments; whole diamonds at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.dragon.desc: Ender Ants fed the dragon's breath in the End. Black and violet, they glow faintly and bring the End's treasures: pearls, purpur, shulker shells and the dragon's breath itself.
species.antcolonies.emerald.desc: Gem-backed ants evolved from Diamond Ants. Bring emerald fragments.
species.antcolonies.ender.desc: Amethyst Ants changed by eyes of ender. Black with violet eyes; bring end stone, chorus and ender pearls, and very rarely shulker shells.
species.antcolonies.excavator.desc: A hybrid of Desert and Deepslate Ants that digs like an archaeologist: bones, pottery sherds, ancient seeds, even sniffer eggs.
species.antcolonies.farmer.desc: Leafcutters that grow fungus gardens. Their Harvesting Sites feed the whole colony.
species.antcolonies.fire.desc: Desert Ants fed blaze powder. They glow like coals and bring the Nether's fuels: blaze powder, magma, wart and quartz.
species.antcolonies.fluorite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed fluorite. Bring fluorite for Mekanism's or MachinaOpus's chemistry.
species.antcolonies.frost_emerald.desc: A hybrid of Snow and Emerald Ants that grows emeralds in the cold.
species.antcolonies.gold.desc: Gilded ants of hot lands. Their nuggets come compressed to ingots with Processing upgrades.
species.antcolonies.harvester.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Savanna Ants, after the real seed-storing harvester ants. Tend Harvesting Sites for crops of every kind.
species.antcolonies.honeypot.desc: A hybrid of Blossom and Farmer Ants. Some workers swell into living honey jars: honey, sugar and comb. Tends Harvesting Sites.
species.antcolonies.inferno.desc: Fire Ants fed blaze powder. They hunt the Nether's fire: blaze rods, magma cream, ghast tears and wither skulls.
species.antcolonies.iron.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed iron. Their armoured bodies shine like polished metal.
species.antcolonies.jungle.desc: Busy ants of the jungle canopy. Bring jungle wood, bamboo, vines, cocoa and melon.
species.antcolonies.lapis.desc: Deep blue ants with lapis plates. Gather lapis lazuli.
species.antcolonies.lead.desc: Heavy, slow Iron Ants fed lead. Bring lead.
species.antcolonies.mechanical_miner.des: A hybrid of Stone and Redstone Ants: tireless miners that bring a bit of everything.
species.antcolonies.molybdenum.desc: Iron Ants fed molybdenum, the metal that hardens MachinaOpus's steel. Bring molybdenum.
species.antcolonies.netherite.desc: The end of the line: heat-forged ants of the Nether. Very slow, very hungry, and the only ants that find netherite.
species.antcolonies.nickel.desc: Iron Ants fed nickel. Bring nickel.
species.antcolonies.obsidian.desc: A hybrid of Stone and Fire Ants: where lava meets stone. Bring obsidian, basalt and magma; crying obsidian at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.osmium.desc: Stone Ants fed osmium. Bring osmium for Mekanism's machines.
species.antcolonies.pale.desc: Ghost-white ants of the pale garden. Bring pale oak, pale moss and resin, and the odd eyeblossom.
species.antcolonies.redstone.desc: Glowing red ants that hum with energy. Gather redstone and, at higher stages, glowstone.
species.antcolonies.reef.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Jungle Ants, as bright as a coral reef. Bring living coral blocks and fans of all five colors.
species.antcolonies.rubber.desc: Wood Ants fed rubber that tap rubber trees. Bring rubber logs and saplings; at a Harvesting Site they bring rubber for MachinaOpus's cables.
species.antcolonies.savanna.desc: Large, bold ants of the savanna. Strip acacia, gather grain and pick over what the herds leave: bones, feathers, hide.
species.antcolonies.sculk.desc: A hybrid of Deepslate and Soul Ants from the deep dark. Bring sculk, sensors and catalysts, and the rare echo shard.
species.antcolonies.shore.desc: Beachcombing ants that work the tideline. Bring sand, kelp and ink, then prismarine and, rarely, nautilus shells.
species.antcolonies.silver.desc: Lead Ants fed silver; they shine like mirrors. Bring silver.
species.antcolonies.snow.desc: Pale ants of the frozen north that thrive where others freeze. Gather snow and ice.
species.antcolonies.soul.desc: Fire Ants touched by soul fire. Live best in the Nether; bring soul sand, basalt and blackstone, and ghast tears.
species.antcolonies.stone.desc: Tough mountain ants that tunnel through rock. Bring stone, gravel and the odd mineral; the start of every mineral line.
species.antcolonies.sulfur.desc: Fire Ants fed sulfur that live around hot vents. Bring sulfur for MachinaOpus's acids without refining oil.
species.antcolonies.swamp.desc: Mud-coated ants of swamps and mangroves. Bring clay, mud, sugar cane and lily pads, and in time slime.
species.antcolonies.tin.desc: Copper Ants fed tin: together they make bronze. Bring tin.
species.antcolonies.trap_jaw.desc: Swamp Ants fed slime balls. Their jaws snap shut faster than anything: slimes, drowned and the odd guardian.
species.antcolonies.uranium.desc: Lead Ants fed raw uranium. They glow green in the dark; bring uranium.
species.antcolonies.warped.desc: Teal ants of the Nether's fungus forests, at home in its heat. Bring netherrack, fungi and nether wart; fed blaze powder in the Nether they become Fire Ants.
species.antcolonies.wither.desc: Soul Ants fed a Nether Star in the Nether. Ash-black and grim, they bring soul sand, coal and bones, wither roses and skulls, and very rarely a Nether Star of their own.
species.antcolonies.wood.desc: Red-chested forest builders of the taiga. Gather logs, sticks and saplings.
species.antcolonies.zinc.desc: Copper Ants fed zinc, ready for Create's brass. Bring zinc.

status.antcolonies.no_storage: No Storage or Foraging Site: the harvest has nowhere to go
status.antcolonies.nothing_to_focus: Nothing of that kind to look for: gathering as Balanced
status.antcolonies.two_colonies: As near to two Terrariums: it joins neither
status.antcolonies.wrong_dimension: This evolution happens only in another dimension (see the Info page)
tooltip.antcolonies.ant_identification_b: A field guide to every ant species.
tooltip.antcolonies.ant_resin: Tree resin that Wood Ants gather. Hardens into Amber building blocks.
tooltip.antcolonies.ant_test_tube.use: Put into a Terrarium of the same species (or an empty one).
tooltip.antcolonies.army_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.badlands_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.

tooltip.antcolonies.brood.use: Put into a Terrarium of the same species: each adds 4.
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_plate: Only from ants: wild ants leave it, and foraging colonies bring it home.
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_set.ants: Wild ants leave you alone (not if you raid their anthill)
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_set.mixed: Mixed tiers count: the lowest tier decides
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_shield: Light: raised faster than a wooden shield, and an axe knocks it down for less time.
tooltip.antcolonies.chorus_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.colony_connector: Links its colony to the other colonies with a connector on the same channel: food moves from colonies with food to spare to those that ask for it, and the items its filter names move between their Storage.
tooltip.antcolonies.colony_scanner: Right-click a Terrarium or colony structure for a report.
tooltip.antcolonies.common_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.crystal_ant_food: Food for crystal species (Amethyst, Diamond, Emerald).
tooltip.antcolonies.desert_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.end_foraging_site: End-adapted ants (Chorus, Ender, Dragon) go on expeditions through its little portal and bring back the End's finds. Other ants leave it alone. No power needed.
tooltip.antcolonies.end_trail_pheromone: The scent of a route through the End. A colony living in the End finds it now and then while foraging. Makes the End Foraging Site.
tooltip.antcolonies.evolution_catalyst: Feed to a Terrarium: doubles the chance of the next evolution attempt.
tooltip.antcolonies.farmer_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.foraging_site: Workers find their species' resources. Sends finds to Storage; holds 9 stacks when it is full.
tooltip.antcolonies.generator: Burns furnace fuel into FE and gives it to the machines next to it, such as the Genetic Laboratory.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_analyzer: Right-click a Terrarium, or use with a Queen in the other hand.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_laboratory: Upgrades, rerolls, mutates and purges a Queen's genes. Runs on FE: put a Generator next to it.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_sample.use: Cross into a daughter in a Queen Chamber's sample slot.
tooltip.antcolonies.guard_ant.use: Use on a block to let it out. Right-click it to make it stay or follow; sneak-right-click to put it back. Ant food heals it.
tooltip.antcolonies.hardened_chitin: Only from ants: sometimes from wild ants, and from colonies of stage 2 and up. For tier II upgrades and the Genetic Laboratory.
tooltip.antcolonies.harvesting_site: Farmer Ants grow food here, plus mushrooms, seeds and berries.
tooltip.antcolonies.hunting_ground: Hunter species kill mobs here: the mobs' loot (from their loot tables; none spawn), and food from the catch.
tooltip.antcolonies.infernal_chitin: Only from ants of the Nether: wild ants there and colonies living there. For tier III upgrades and high genetics.
tooltip.antcolonies.infernal_reinforceme: Smithing template: turns Hardened Chitin gear into Infernal with a piece of Infernal Chitin.
tooltip.antcolonies.jungle_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.mineral_ant_food: Food for mineral species; their eggs need it.
tooltip.antcolonies.nest_chamber: Brood and housing: eggs at full speed, faster larvae, room for 3,000 adults and 1,500 larvae.
tooltip.antcolonies.nether_foraging_site: Nether-adapted ants (Warped, Fire, Inferno, Soul, Netherite, Wither, Crimson) go on expeditions through its little portal and bring back the Nether's finds. Other ants leave it alone. No power needed.
tooltip.antcolonies.nether_trail_pheromo: The scent of a route through the Nether. A colony living in the Nether finds it now and then while foraging. Makes the Nether Foraging Site.
tooltip.antcolonies.nuptial_pheromone: Needed to rear Queens of advanced species.
tooltip.antcolonies.pale_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.

tooltip.antcolonies.royal_jelly: Rich food (400) and the base of Queen rearing.

tooltip.antcolonies.storage: More room for what the colony finds, and food room. Hoppers can empty it; Storage Upgrades open more slots.
tooltip.antcolonies.swamp_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.terrarium: The heart of a colony. Put a Queen in and feed her. Chambers placed against it, or against its chambers, join the colony. Take the Queen and ants out in Test Tubes before breaking it: what is left inside is lost.
tooltip.antcolonies.test_tube: Holds caught ants. Keep some in your inventory when using Tweezers.
tooltip.antcolonies.tweezers: Catches wild ants into empty Test Tubes in your inventory. Also works on wild nests.
tooltip.antcolonies.tweezers.terrarium: On a Terrarium: take workers (sneak: eggs) to start another colony.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.adds_up: Two of a kind in one block add up.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.automation: Storage: pushes its finds into the container below.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.breeding: Faster egg laying and Queen rearing.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.genetic: Cheaper lab work; more mutations in Queen Chambers.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.hunting: Hunting Ground: stronger hunters, more catches, fewer losses.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.population: More ants housed, or more working in one chamber.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.simulation: Terrarium: more offline catch-up (numbers only, no entities).
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.speed: Faster work in chambers and the lab, faster larvae.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.storage: Storage: more slots and more food room.
